[SWS_LOG_00229] Display of argument attributes in console output
⌈
If a payload
argument contains a name attribute, then the name attribute shall be prepended to
the argument value, and separated from the value with a colon character (U+003a). If a
payload argument contains a unit attribute, then the unit attribute shall be appended
to the argument value, and separated from the value with a colon character (U+003a)
as well.
⌋
(RS_LT_00056, RS_LT_00002)
Example:
speed:42.1:km/h
, where speed is the value of the name attribute, and
km/h is the value of the unit attribute
The following subsections details how the data types that are supported by the ara::log
API are being represented in console output.
7.8.2.2.1 bool
